text: Age of Peace now really ignores action cards: no more "stop this action?" prompts for actions that won't happen.
Prosperity: you can now end your turn without stabilizing.
Yes/No prompts (like Age of Exploration's discard-to-draw) now show your hand.
"Each player" ages like Age of Exploration now ask every player, not just the first.
Reaction prompts show the card art, and you can tap (i) to read a reaction card before choosing it.
Phone layout is more compact, so your whole trait pile fits without scrolling.
